The `inputRowIds.includes(rowId)` check inside `sourceRowIds.some` performs a linear scan, resulting in O(N * M) complexity. Converting `inputRowIds` to a `Set` beforehand reduces the lookup complexity to O(N + M), which is much more efficient and adheres to the repository's general rules.

```suggestion
  const inputRowIdsSet = new Set(inputRowIds);
  if (sourceRowIds.length === 0 || sourceRowIds.some((rowId) => !inputRowIdsSet.has(rowId))) {
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

To prevent any potential operator precedence confusion (since `&&` has higher precedence than `||` in JavaScript), it is highly recommended to use explicit parentheses to make the evaluation order clear and unambiguous.

```suggestion
        high_risk: rule.risk_tier === HIGH_RISK_TIER || (rule.auto_accept_allowed === false &&
          rule.human_review_required === true),
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

To prevent operator precedence confusion and ensure the condition is evaluated exactly as intended, use explicit parentheses around the logical AND expression.

```suggestion
    if (hasPromotionSignal(assertion) || (confidenceIsHigh(assertion) && directFields.length > 0)) {
```
